chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Backbiting is the tool of the helpless.

key_terms.الْعَاجزِ: The helpless; the powerless; one lacking strength or ability
key_terms.الْغِيبَةُ: Backbiting; mentioning a person in their absence
key_terms.جُهْدُ: Effort; tool; means; the exertion of the weak

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of backbiting being the tool of the helpless?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) defines backbiting (ghibah) as the 'juhd' (effort or exertion) of the powerless, highlighting it as a compensatory mechanism for those lacking the authority or strength to confront others directly. This metaphor underscores the psychological and social dynamics of weakness, where the tongue becomes the weapon of the physically or socially constrained. The term 'juhd' specifically implies a deliberate exertion of energy, suggesting that backbiting is an active, albeit inferior, form of engagement.
